algorithm: sha256 over sorted lines '<git blob id>  <path>' for every file in the tree
effective_profile_rule: the observed toggle values, the registered capabilities and their state, and the layer identities; volatile fields (timestamps, commit ids, working directory) are deliberately absent, so the same configuration gives the same value whatever day it is taken
layers_note: The four layers are separate on purpose: protocol_generation describes the wire contract, service_build_id the server code, knowledge_bundle_id the shipped knowledge assets, and effective_profile_id what actually took effect this run. A caller needs the last two together - the resolvable release manifest identifier and the configuration that was in force.
taken_at_commit_note: HEAD when the identity was taken. With --source index the record is taken against the staged tree and ships in the commit that tree becomes; the records are excluded from their own coverage, so the value is unaffected.
coverage: every file of the tree (HEAD, or the staged tree with --source index) except the identity record and the release manifest
